role: Independent AI read-only engineering novelty advisory; not student final question, design, paper, ownership account or human review
assessment: Existing primary-methods matrix is substantively cautious and largely correct. No general new gradient-certification, descent-certification, Green-function gradient, coarse correction, or Krylov theorem is established. The potentially supportable contribution remains a precisely scoped discrete-operator implementation and its honest full-cost/abstention evidence. Priority for its exact recipe remains unresolved.
material_scope_clarifications: The LIVE five-control adapter performs classical cached sparse-LU merit, low-sine/DST missing-field proposals, optional component certification and exact fallback. It executes no neural-network or POD inference. Any later positive result here cannot establish neural-operator derivative certification, learned-model necessity or learned-surrogate acceleration.

All five controls use the same paid reference objective for finite-step acceptance. The certificate controls raw-direction admission and fallback; paid decrease controls accepted finite steps. It cannot be credited with unique finite-step monotonic safety. Clipping changes the direction and the certificate does not cover the clipped displacement.

The certificate is limited to the five-point constant-spacing real-Dirichlet stiffness plus complex diagonal potential, real squared slowness and fixed source/receiver maps. Separate Devito forward reproduction does not transfer this certificate to Devito, PML, elasticity or continuum physics.

Exact-arithmetic inequalities evaluated in ordinary floating point with heuristic Gram allowances are not verified numerical enclosures. Successful discrete tests cannot justify a guaranteed floating-point certificate.

additional_primary_gap_to_record.implication: Optimization-aware inexact linear algebra and conditions preserving descent predate this project. Do not claim first avoiding oversolving or first paying only for descent accuracy. Its practical unknown-gradient substitution is not a drop-in theorem validating this code.

concrete_unresolved_differentiators: Is residual orientation through Ar^-1 and receiver/source coupling materially sharper than a valid specialization of prior state/adjoint bounds on identical fields, direction and operator? Replacing norms or naming a direction is not by itself new mathematics.

Does conditional certification add useful performance beyond identical fixed-sweep fields with the same paid objective and fallback? Same-M converged GMRES and cached exact LU/L-BFGS-B must retain their legal reuse. A useful preconditioner is distinct from a useful certificate.

What exact additional computational advantage survives ordinary Green-function identities and the best implemented incremental exact route? min(s,r-c) or min(r,s-c) counts describe implemented routes, not global lower bounds; low-rank data/source structure could permit other exact implementations.

Can a claimed advantage survive complete preparation/setup/rejection/return-tail costs and stability unavailability? Fixed-rank gamma/tau restrictions and reduced cubic work constrain the regime; tiny-grid comparisons cannot establish scalable Helmholtz superiority.

Specific complex transpose/conjugation, source-amplitude squared, duplicate-slot sums, nonzero paid-field residuals, affine defects, fail-closed ownership and complete cost receipts are strong correctness work. They do not establish priority or a new physical model.

Reused correlated validation slices, one discrete boundary model and AI-authored implementation support development evidence only. Independent geology, a student-owned contribution and substantive human mathematical review remain separate outstanding requirements.
safe_technical_scope_not_student_submiss: An ordinary-floating-point implementation specializes established adjoint/duality error bounds to owner-validated cached merit fields for one finite complex-symmetric Helmholtz discretization. It exposes directional abstention and compares full returned-cost behavior against cached exact and same-preconditioner controls. Whether it improves time to target is an outcome question not assessed in this live-run review.
review_limit: Targeted primary-source verification, not exhaustive search or novelty clearance. No live benchmark result, rank, winner, acceleration, human authorship or research-goal completion is inferred.
